defs.def: to take part in the sport of riding on waves on a surfboard 进行冲浪运动；冲浪

ex.s: In your free time, you can explore the city, have language classes, surf or choose your favourite from among the following.
ex.t: 空闲时，你可以探索城市、上语言课、冲浪或从以下选择你喜欢的。

ex.s: Watch surfers who catch the waves- and maybe even give it a go yourself!
ex.t: 看冲浪者谁赶上浪 -- 甚至可能给它自己去!

defs.def: to use the Internet （互联网上）冲浪，漫游，浏览

ex.s: After a while, she discovered that surfing the Internet could help her feel less lonely and bored.
ex.t: 过了一段时间,她发现冲浪互联网可以帮助她感到不那么孤独和无聊.

ex.s: Examples from the text More examples you know access convenient surf inspire distance network download cash update benefit The Internet has brought great to Wuzhen, a small waterside town in Zhejiang Province.
ex.t: 网易为浙江省水边小镇吴zh带来巨大好处。

ex.s: Surf the Internet to research different forms of poetry and discover their formats.
ex.t: 冲网研究不同形式的诗歌并发现其格式.

ex.s: Surf the Internet and find more facts about the measures taken to strengthen your assessment.
ex.t: 冲上互联网,发现更多事实,说明为加强你的评估所采取的措施。
